name: Sesame Chicken Soba Noodle Bowl with Broccoli, Carrots & Miso Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, add broccoli, noodles, and salt; cook until broccoli and noodles are tender, 5-6 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under warm water (from the tap); set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
425 g soba (buckwheat) noodles
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice limes into a large bowl.
Add miso paste, vinegar, water, oil, and soy sauce to the bowl with the lime juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup miso paste, white
⅓ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the broccoli and noodles, then toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide noodles, chicken, and veggies between bowls; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
